note: Provisional. Bundle budgets are the node zlib gzip size of each emitted asset. The initial payload is the set of assets `dist/index.html` references, which is what the first paint waits on. A lazy chunk is any other emitted asset, fetched the first time its route opens, and each chunk is gated against the same per-chunk ceiling. Timing budgets are milliseconds, checked against the median of 5 runs recorded by e2e/specs/budget.spec.ts. Measured on this box with a debug build of `romeka`, where one authenticated /api request costs about 118 ms in bcrypt key verification, so the timing budgets have room for slow CI rather than a tight frontend bound. createRoundTrip was 700 while a create paid two API rounds; the item show page now renders the record the POST returned, so the path pays one round like the list and the detail renders, and 400 keeps the same room. See PERF.md for the measurements. The eager bundle was 103351 B gzip, over the original 102400 B budget; the router split took the initial payload to 85354 B, so the budget is back to 102400 and the largest lazy chunk, 6909 B, sets the 10240 B per-chunk ceiling (PERF.md, Decision 5). The auth surface took the payload to 88411 B and the largest chunk to 6965 B, still inside both (Decision 6). The site settings help text took the payload to 103180 B, and the budget moved to 103424 until only the active locale loads (Decision 9). Loading only the active locale took the payload to 91807 B, so the budget is 93184, which leaves 1377 B; a catalogue chunk, which a visitor in that locale fetches before the first render, has its own 13312 B ceiling, set from the 12003 B Spanish chunk (Decision 11). Seven Indic catalogues, 3 bytes a letter in UTF-8, measured up to 15216 B (Malayalam), so that ceiling is 16384 (Decision 13). The admin locale and translated server errors took the payload past 93184, so it is 94208 until the English catalogue splits by route (Decision 14). The English catalogue split into the shell's 55 keys and lazy message namespaces, one per route family (src/i18n/namespaces/), which took the payload from 94056 B to 84680 B, so the ceiling is 87040, about 2.5 KB over it; every locale table, shell or namespace, is now a catalogue chunk, and the largest, 10180 B (the Malayalam vocabulary comments), sets the catalogue ceiling at 11264 (Decision 20). The multimedia run spent the 2.4 KB of room on the media wire members every list parses (kind, preview, access) and on the shared upload client; the payload measured 87041 B, so the ceiling is 88064 (Decision 29). The media document parser, the vocabulary document parser and the write encoders then moved into modules the routes that read them import, which took the payload to 85088 B, so the ceiling is 87552, the measured payload plus 2464 B (Decision 31).
